program.section_heading: Paramedic - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - MAS585/MAS585B/MAS585C/MCE585
outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to analyze medical and psycho-social strategies while diagnosing and treating illnesses or injuries.
Perform assessments and treatments that show integration of modern technology and current treatment protocols.
Evaluate complex medical and emergency conditions and implement emergency scene management strategies to ensure the health and safety of emergency services workers and patients.

Defend the use of active listening and communication skills so as to render empathetic, respectful, and compassionate patient care and foster constructive relationships with fellow emergency services workers.

notes: The page prints one combined section for the A.S. Degree and Certificate of Achievement; the single Program Requirements list (38.50 units) and the Program Learning Outcomes are shared by both awards and are recorded here for the A.S.
The catalog prints codes with a hyphen (EMS-60); these were matched to closed-list entries written as 'EMS 60' or 'EMS70' (no space), so none are treated as catalog additions.

The closed list stores no units for EMS70, EMS80, EMS82, EMS91; units recorded are those printed in the catalog (2.5, 4, 2.5, 8.5). The closed list title 'Speical Topics' for EMS82 is a misspelling of the catalog's 'Special Topics'.
The degree text refers to general education requirements 'as described in the college catalog' without naming a specific GE pattern, so ge_pattern is null.
The section heading appears in variant forms (MAS585/C/MCE585 and MAS585/MAS585B/MAS585C/MCE585); the fullest form is recorded.
